summary.zh: GLM-5.2 语言模型已在 OmniMux 可调用。

body.en:
## GLM-5.2

**GLM-5.2** is now available on OmniMux (with related GLM IDs on pricing).

### New models

- **Model IDs:** `glm-5.2`, `glm-5.1`
- **API:** Chat Completions at `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1`
